english: Don't count them!\nAre you an idiot?
Listen closely.\nA special unit\nisn't something you...
Want to cut your belly\nfor real...?
Ten years won't cover it!\nJust commit seppuku, idiot!
Hijikata, then.\nAbout that Gin Tama business...

And depending on how
you use them, those orbs
can double as weapons. If Joui rebels
get hold of them...
Ready, Kondo?\fHere's a quick\nexplanation of Gin Tama.
Take notes. Ask questions\nif there's anything\nyou don't get.
That's what I was\njust explaining.\fListen. Gin Tama are...
A bit too advanced\nfor you, Kondo?
Should I kill them after all?
After rare gold orbs?\nA serial castrator, maybe?
...Even nonsense is real\nto someone who believes it.
By the way, Sougo.\fI know about Gin Tama,\nbut... You know...\nBattles?
How did you get that?!\nFollow the conversation!
I wondered if they were\nafter rare gold orbs.
No, not that.\fApart from ordinary orbs,\nthere are rare ones\ncalled Dragon Tama.
Sounds like nonsense to me.\fSeven Dragon Tama, I think.\nCollect that many...
I agree. But if people\nspread it as the truth...
And Gin Tama battles\nare only getting\nmore heated...
I'm following perfectly.\fYou've never played\na Gin Tama battle,\nso you don't know them.

Vice-Chief, I am
an undercover officer. I know more about Gin Tama
and Gin Tama battles
than anyone in our ranks.

Sorry.
I shouldn't have interfered... But please be careful.
You're our vice-chief.
The Shinsengumi needs you.
Oh... So is there\na Yamazaki character orb?

Oh dear. Even you
struggle at first,
Vice-Chief. The orbs I lent you
weren't great, either.
That's how it starts. Collect more orbs
and get some practice.
You'll be fine.
Ignore these two.\nPlease go on.\fDid you see\nanyone suspicious?
Looks certain now.\nThe thief's after\nDragon Tama.
Then say so\nin the first place, idiot!
Stop, Kondo.\nYou're embarrassing us!\fWhy do you even\nwant that thing?
Why ME?! Isn't this\nbetween you and Kondo?!
Fine, I get it!\nBattle, whatever!\nI'll take you on!
Seven of those\ngrant a wish, right?
I need a fortune! Enough\nto make forty years\nwithout pay worth it!
What?! You'd charge\nME money for it?!
That's why I need\nto get a Dragon Tama...
Either way!\nHurry up! Move it!\fOr I'll make you\ncommit seppuku!
Got the Dragon Tama!\nLet's go, Toshi!
Yes. The whole bag\nI'd left at my feet...

Not Gin Tama! Gold!
Rare gold orbs! I worked so hard
to get those precious
rare gold orbs!
Sorry. I didn't\nnotice a thing\nwhen it happened...
Yes, understood.\nPlease help.\fPlease get\nmy Dragon Tama back!

...This is a dead end,
Hijikata. He saw nothing.
We've got no leads
to go on.

Exactly. Apparently they sell
for ridiculous prices. One Dragon Tama
could feed you
for six months.
No, Kondo.\nI can't give you this.
Hold on. I'm willing\nto part with it,\nbut not for free...
No, I mean,\nhow about a Gin Tama battle?
It's fine. Kondo's been\ncollecting Gin Tama too.
Right, then.\nLet's have a battle.\fGood luck, Hijikata.
I'd rather watch\nthis sort of contest.\fI can point\nand laugh at you.
Seppuku, he says.\nHear that, Hijikata?\n...Win, and the orb's yours.
Don't talk like\nYOU did the fighting!
Yes! I won!\nThe Dragon Tama's mine!
Six more to go!\nI'm doing this!
A promise is a promise.\nCan't be helped.\fHere, Kondo.\nThis orb's yours.
It was a fair fight.\nDon't worry about it.
Damn it, Sougo!\nOne more round! Please!
No. A serious match\nis a one-time deal.\nThat's the rule.
You should consider\nwhat your opponent wants...
Kondo, you've lost sight\nof the point already...
If only his motives\nwere right too...
Of course.\nI'd know that face anywhere...
Huh? Isn't that a Gin Tama?\nNo, a Dragon Tama!
Why does Katsura\nhave a Dragon Tama?\nIs he involved in this...?
You noticed too, Hijikata?\f...Looks like\nit really is him.
...Katsura. You just\ngot a Dragon Tama\nfrom someone, didn't you?
We have a little\nbusiness with you.\nHand over that orb.
You won't?\nThen there's only\none thing for it...
What do you want?\nI'm not Katsura...
No point running, is there?\nI'll take you on.
Katsura! Where's\nthe Dragon Tama?!\nOut with it! Now!
Beat Toshi, and\nwe'll let you go quietly.
But, Katsura!\fLose to Toshi,\nand the Dragon Tama's mine!
...No. Not this orb.\nI can't hand it over.
Say what you like.\nBut this orb...\n...Forgive me!
Don't dismiss Gin Tama\nas just another fad.
Damn! You two\ndo as you please!
If I won, you'd\nlet me leave quietly.\nThat was the deal.
That's it, Hijikata!\nAt times like this...
I know someone who\nloves this sort of thing.\fWhy not go\nand ask them about it?
...Gin Tama? No...\nThis is about Dragon Tama?
Someone here's saying\nmuch the same thing...
...So, what do you want\nwith that freeloader?
